verdict.rationale: Reclaim offers Scheduling Links for bookings, so a booking-event webhooks story applies to it. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for booking creation, rescheduling, or cancellation. The Slack status sync and the auth-gated MCP endpoint are adjacent features, not webhooks, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
